description: Find people on Alion for a role - engineers, data and product people, designers, founders - by role, technologies (with years), seniority, country, the countries they may work in, work mode, relocation, languages, English level, kind of work, availability, budget, degree, past employer or free words; at least one of role, technology, query or company is required. Each row is a short card: handle, name and pay expectation (when the person shows them), headline, seniority, years, skills with years, recent jobs, location, work modes, availability and why (the facts behind its place). Only people open to offers who left their profile open to agents are listed; no email or phone is ever served. Then: get_person to read, check_fit before writing, send_message to write. Free; limits by trust: no account 50 profile reads and 20 searches a day per network, a wallet signed in with SIWX 100 and 50, an Alion account 1,000 and 200, a verified company 5,000 and 1,000. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

active_within_days.description: Only people active on Alion in this many days.

availability.description: actively_looking only, or everyone open to offers (the default).

budget_usd.description: The most the role pays a year in USD: people who expect more are left out.

can_work_in.description: Where the person may work (lives there, holds a permit or citizenship): ISO codes (a comma list) or a region - EU, EEA, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, LATAM, GCC.

company.description: Worked (or works) at this company: name or domain.

country.description: Where the person lives: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (a comma list) or a region - EU, EEA, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, LATAM, GCC.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page (a search does not page past row 100).

employment_type.description: A kind of work the person takes.

has_github.description: Only people with their GitHub on the profile.

languages.description: Spoken languages, a comma list ("German, French"); all required.

min_years.description: Years with each named technology (or in total when none is named).

open_to.description: What the person says they are open to here: a job, freelance projects, a CTO role, a co-founder, angel investing.

query.description: Free words over titles, summaries, employers and skills ("computer vision drones"): every word is needed, as a whole word; "a phrase" in quotes, -word leaves out, ~word only ranks, OR joins two.

role.description: Role family or specialisation, e.g. "Backend", "Data Engineer", "Product Manager" (alion://dictionaries/role-families).

seniority.description: One or a comma list: intern, junior, middle, senior, staff, principal, lead, head, architect.

sort.description: best_match (default), recent_activity (last active first) or experience (most years first).

technology.description: Technologies the person must have, a comma list ("Python, PostgreSQL"); every one is required. Names as people write them: React, NodeJS, Vue, Apache Spark, k8s, Golang.

work_mode.description: A work mode the person accepts.

name: search_people
title: Search people
